[{"insert":"Back Squat

The back squat comes in at higher reps this block to build your legs and your work capacity. Brace hard before every rep by taking a big breath, squeezing your midsection, then breaking at the hips and knees together. Most missed reps in a high rep set come when bracing slips, not when the legs give out. Keep your depth and speed the same from the first rep to the last.
"}]
